enableServiceLinks.description: Whether Kubernetes injects environment variables for the Services of the namespace into the containers (`enableServiceLinks`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

hostNetwork.description: Whether the pods use the network namespace of the node (`hostNetwork`). `dnsPolicy` is set to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` automatically when this is `true`. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

hostPID.description: Whether the containers can see the processes of the node (`hostPID`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

hostIPC.description: Whether the containers share the IPC namespace of the node (`hostIPC`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

shareProcessNamespace.description: Whether all containers of a pod share one process namespace (`shareProcessNamespace`), so they can see and signal each other's processes. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

affinity.description: Affinity rules of the pods (`podAffinity` and `podAntiAffinity`), passed on as is. Merged over the default affinity when `defaultAffinity` is enabled. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy of the pods (`dnsPolicy`): `ClusterFirst`, `ClusterFirstWithHostNet`, `Default` or `None`. It is forced to `ClusterFirstWithHostNet` when `hostNetwork` is `true`. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

dnsConfig.description: Extra DNS settings of the pods (`dnsConfig`): nameservers, search domains and resolver options. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

hostAliases.description: Extra entries for the `/etc/hosts` file of the pods (`hostAliases`), each with an IP and its host names. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

nodeSelector.description: Labels a node must have for the pods to be scheduled on it (`nodeSelector`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

defaultSpread.description: Adds a default topology spread constraint to Deployments and StatefulSets, so their pods are spread across nodes on a best-effort basis.

defaultAffinity.description: Adds a default pod affinity to Deployments and StatefulSets, so pods that mount the same PVCs are scheduled on the same node.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: How the pods are spread across topology domains such as nodes or zones (`topologySpreadConstraints`). Added after the constraints of `defaultSpread`. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

tolerations.description: Taints the pods tolerate (`tolerations`), so they can be scheduled on tainted nodes. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

schedulerName.description: Name of the scheduler that schedules the pods (`schedulerName`). The default scheduler is used when empty. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

priorityClassName.description: Name of the PriorityClass of the pods (`priorityClassName`), which sets their scheduling priority. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

runtimeClassName.description: Name of the RuntimeClass of the pods (`runtimeClassName`), to run them with another container runtime. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Whether the service account token is mounted into the pods (`automountServiceAccountToken`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes waits for the containers to stop after they receive SIGTERM, before it kills them (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`). Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

hostUsers.description: Whether the pods use the user namespace of the node (`hostUsers`). When `false`, the pod gets its own user namespace. When not set, common calculates it. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

restartPolicy.description: Restart policy of the pods (`restartPolicy`): `Always`, `OnFailure` or `Never`. Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets only allow `Always`. Jobs and CronJobs default to `OnFailure` and do not allow `Always`. Can be overridden per workload in `workload.<name>.podSpec`.

description: Options that apply to all pods, unless a workload overrides them in `workload.<name>.podSpec`. See [podOptions](/truecharts-common/podOptions).
